Blessing of Triumph
13% of base mana
Instant cast3 min cooldown
Redeem a Blessed ally for 20 sec, granting 25% increased haste and 10% increased damage.

If the ally falls below 35% maximum health they are healed for 10% of their direct damage dealt for the remaining duration.

Only usable on your ally with Bless active.
